builtin.name: builtin
builtin.do:
if [ -n "$BUILDKIT_SYNTAX" ]; then
  # depot frontend-pin workaround (full rationale in stacks/sayt/sayt.cue)
  find /monorepo -path '*/.bayt/Dockerfile.*' -type f -exec sed -i "1i # syntax=$BUILDKIT_SYNTAX" {} \;
fi
[ -n "$BKID_PROJECT" ] || { echo "bkid: BKID_PROJECT is unset; sayt integrate names the inner stack" >&2; exit 1; }
p="${BKID_PROJECT}_visual"
f=.bayt/compose.integrate.closure.yaml
[ -n "$DEPOT_TOKEN" ] && bake="depot bake --project $DEPOT_PROJECT_ID" || bake="docker buildx bake"
docker compose -p "$p" --profile '*' -f "$f" config | docker buildx bake --allow=fs.read=/monorepo -f - --print bayt | $bake -f - ${SAYT_NO_CACHE:+--no-cache --set "*.cache-from=" --set "*.cache-to="} ${SAYT_NO_CACHE_FROM:+--set "*.cache-from="} ${SAYT_NO_CACHE_TO:+--set "*.cache-to="} bayt
docker compose -p "$p" --profile '*' -f "$f" down -v --timeout 0 --remove-orphans
s=0
docker compose -p "$p" --profile '*' -f "$f" up bayt --build --abort-on-container-failure --exit-code-from bayt --remove-orphans --attach-dependencies || s=$?
docker compose -p "$p" --profile '*' -f "$f" down -v --timeout 0 --remove-orphans
exit "$s"

builtin.name: builtin
builtin.do:
if [ -n "$BUILDKIT_SYNTAX" ]; then
  # depot frontend-pin workaround (full rationale in stacks/sayt/sayt.cue)
  find /monorepo -path '*/.bayt/Dockerfile.*' -type f -exec sed -i "1i # syntax=$BUILDKIT_SYNTAX" {} \;
fi
[ -n "$BKID_PROJECT" ] || { echo "bkid: BKID_PROJECT is unset; sayt integrate names the inner stack" >&2; exit 1; }
p="${BKID_PROJECT}_favorites"
f=.bayt/compose.check-favorites.closure.yaml
[ -n "$DEPOT_TOKEN" ] && bake="depot bake --project $DEPOT_PROJECT_ID" || bake="docker buildx bake"
docker compose -p "$p" --profile '*' -f "$f" config | docker buildx bake --allow=fs.read=/monorepo -f - --print bayt | $bake -f - ${SAYT_NO_CACHE:+--no-cache --set "*.cache-from=" --set "*.cache-to="} ${SAYT_NO_CACHE_FROM:+--set "*.cache-from="} ${SAYT_NO_CACHE_TO:+--set "*.cache-to="} bayt
docker compose -p "$p" --profile '*' -f "$f" down -v --timeout 0 --remove-orphans
s=0
docker compose -p "$p" --profile '*' -f "$f" up bayt --build --abort-on-container-failure --exit-code-from bayt --remove-orphans --attach-dependencies || s=$?
docker compose -p "$p" --profile '*' -f "$f" down -v --timeout 0 --remove-orphans
exit "$s"

' "$PRONTO_RELEASE_SCRIPTS" >> /etc/caddy/env; set -e -o pipefail; roots=$(caddy adapt --envfile /etc/caddy/env --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile | tr , '

defmodule Mecha.SnapshotWaiterRegression do
  alias Electric.Shapes.Consumer
  alias Consumer.State

  defmodule Storage do
    def supports_txn_fragment_streaming?, do: true
    def fetch_latest_offset(_), do: {:ok, Electric.Replication.LogOffset.last_before_real_offsets()}
    def fetch_pg_snapshot(snapshot), do: {:ok, snapshot}
    def mark_snapshot_as_started(_), do: :ok
  end

  def run do
    stack = "mecha-snapshot-waiter-regression"
    metadata = :ets.new(:"shape_meta_table:#{stack}", [:named_table, :public])

    try do
      for snapshot <- [nil, %{xmin: 10, xmax: 20, xip_list: [15], filter_txns?: false}] do
        handle = if snapshot == nil, do: "fresh", else: "restored"
        :ets.insert(metadata, {handle, 0, false, nil, 0})
        state = %State{stack_id: stack, shape_handle: handle}
        refs = [make_ref(), make_ref()]

        waiting = Enum.reduce(refs, state, fn ref, state ->
          {:noreply, state, _} = Consumer.handle_call(:await_snapshot_start, {self(), ref}, state)
          state
        end)

        initialized = State.initialize(waiting, {Storage, snapshot}, nil)
        expected_snapshot = if snapshot == nil, do: nil, else: {10, 20, [15]}
        ^expected_snapshot = initialized.initial_snapshot_state.pg_snapshot
        expected_buffering = snapshot == nil
        ^expected_buffering = initialized.buffering?
        ^expected_buffering = initialized.initial_snapshot_state.filtering?

        late = make_ref()
        {:noreply, initialized, _} = Consumer.handle_call(:await_snapshot_start, {self(), late}, initialized)
        {:noreply, started, _} = Consumer.handle_cast({:snapshot_started, handle}, initialized)

        for ref <- refs ++ [late] do
          receive do
            {^ref, :started} -> :ok
          after
            0 -> raise "#{handle}: initialization discarded a waiting snapshot caller"
          end
        end

        [] = started.initial_snapshot_state.awaiting_snapshot_start
        true = Electric.ShapeCache.ShapeStatus.snapshot_started?(stack, handle)
        {:reply, :started, _, _} = Consumer.handle_call(:await_snapshot_start, {self(), make_ref()}, started)
        {:noreply, _, _} = Consumer.handle_cast({:snapshot_started, handle}, started)

        receive do
          {_ref, :started} -> raise "#{handle}: snapshot caller replied twice"
        after
          0 -> :ok
        end
      end
    after
      :ets.delete(metadata)
    end

    IO.puts("Electric snapshot waiters survive fresh and restored initialization")
  end
end

if System.get_env("MECHA_ELECTRIC_TEST_ONLY") == "1" do
  Mecha.SnapshotWaiterRegression.run()
else
  "1.8.1" = Application.spec(:electric, :vsn) |> List.to_string()
  source_url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/electric-sql/electric/0f404200402f918a4b1596bc5c8a53479a435349/packages/sync-service/lib/electric/shapes/consumer/state.ex"
  checksum = "e94be3ef70ebcca4e072db4ba537dddcd77a1af5b9137e24c92651076f8862cb"

  source = case System.cmd("curl", ["--fail", "--silent", "--show-error", "--location", source_url], stderr_to_stdout: true) do
    {source, 0} -> source
    {error, status} -> raise "Electric source fetch failed (#{status}): #{error}"
  end

  ^checksum = :crypto.hash(:sha256, source) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
  before = "    initial_snapshot_state = InitialSnapshot.new(pg_snapshot)"
  replacement = """
      initial_snapshot_state = %{
        InitialSnapshot.new(pg_snapshot)
        | awaiting_snapshot_start: state.initial_snapshot_state.awaiting_snapshot_start
      }
  """ |> String.trim_trailing()
  [prefix, suffix] = String.split(source, before)

  module = Electric.Shapes.Consumer.State
  Code.ensure_loaded!(module)
  beam_path = :code.which(module)
  Code.compiler_options(ignore_module_conflict: true)
  [{^module, beam}] = Code.compile_string(prefix <> replacement <> suffix, "lib/electric/shapes/consumer/state.ex")
  Mecha.SnapshotWaiterRegression.run()
  File.write!(beam_path, beam)
end

ELIXIR

epilogue:
COPY <<'CDCTRACE' /cdc-trace.yaml
# The change feed's transaction trace, joined onto every row: shared by every
# stream reading cdc-events through the transform's `-r`, since streams mode
# refuses resources in a stream's own file.
#
# A writing transaction's first change on the bus is its marker
# (mecha.txn_trace, rls.sql), and conduit does not interleave transactions, so
# the marker last read is the transaction of every row after it. A row's own
# txid cannot answer instead: the bus spells a delete as its before-image,
# indistinguishable from an insert, and that image's txid, where it carries
# more than its key, is its last writer's.
#
# A stream runs this among its INPUT processors, which Connect runs on one
# goroutine whatever the pipeline's threads, after stamping @cdc_consumer with
# a name no other stream uses: the cache is one per process, and each stream
# reads the bus at its own position. The marker is consumed and dropped; a
# row leaves with @traceparent set to its transaction's trace, or unset when
# the transaction had none or began before this process read its marker.
cache_resources:
  - label: cdc_trace
    memory:
      # One entry per stream, replaced by every marker: the TTL bounds nothing
      # and only has to outlast the longest transaction's rows (the default
      # is 5m).
      default_ttl: 24h

processor_resources:
  - label: cdc_trace_join
    # A batch runs each processor over every message before the next, so a
    # marker mid-batch would reach the rows after it only once the batch had
    # already read the cache; for_each runs the batch a message at a time.
    for_each:
      - switch:
          - check: '@cdc_consumer.or("") == ""'
            processors:
              - crash: a cdc-events stream ran cdc_trace_join without stamping @cdc_consumer
          - check: this.catch({}).data.or("").catch("").parse_json().catch({}).__table.or("") == "txn_trace"
            processors:
              # A marker without its NOT NULL trace keeps the error and stays
              # on the stream, where the consumer refuses it as it would any
              # malformed row.
              - try:
                  - mapping: |
                      let trace = this.data.parse_json().traceparent
                      root = if $trace.type() == "string" { $trace } else { throw("txn_trace marker has no traceparent") }
                  - cache:
                      resource: cdc_trace
                      operator: set
                      key: ${! @cdc_consumer }
                      value: ${! content() }
                  - mapping: root = deleted()
          - processors:
              - branch:
                  request_map: root = ""
                  processors:
                    - cache:
                        resource: cdc_trace
                        operator: get
                        key: ${! @cdc_consumer }
                    # No marker read yet: the transaction's trace is unknown.
                    - catch:
                        - mapping: root = ""
                  result_map: meta traceparent = if content().string() != "" { content().string() } else { deleted() }

  # A coalesced call's @traceparent, over a batch archived as a JSON array whose
  # elements carry their row's @traceparent as `trace` (archive keeps no
  # metadata): the first transaction's trace, the one that set the call off.
  - label: cdc_trace_batch
    mutation: |
      let traces = this.map_each(m -> m.trace).filter(t -> t != "")
      meta traceparent = if $traces.length() > 0 { $traces.index(0) } else { deleted() }

CDCTRACE
